candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show order spans failing with 500 Internal Server Error for every checkout correlation, and gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout with no dependency-operation series.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db pool, redis, config) not established; order-side logs and dependency metrics were not admitted.

report.explanation: Traces show order POST /v1/orders failing with 500 and gateway /v1/checkout returning 502 for the same correlations; gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout. This bounds the fault to order-side 500s, but the specific internal cause is not yet evidenced, so only the http-500 candidate is offered.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and error details for the 500 responses
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to distinguish pool exhaustion vs redis timeout vs config
